topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: When I found out that my child has the same teacher I had, a knot formed in my stomach. Memories, some good, many not, came rushing back. I tried to tell myself that times have changed, people change, but the old classroom flashed before my eyes, and I wondered if my child would share the same experience. I know I should be positive, support my child, and give the teacher a fair chance. It’s just hard when the past feels so present. I’m drafting a letter to introduce myself, to explain my reservations, to see if we can start on a better note, but every word I write feels heavy, loaded with unspoken worries.
